info.title: Junjo AI Studio
info.description: The Junjo AI Studio API: observability, execution evidence, and evaluation control.

post.summary: Flush ingestion's write-ahead log to cold Parquet files and index them.
post.description:
Spans normally become cold files when the log fills. This makes them cold,
and indexed, now.

200.description: The log was flushed and its files indexed.

500.description: The flush or the indexing failed.

get.summary: List the Agent executions of one service, newest first.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Only executions that started at or after this instant.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Only executions that ended at or before this instant.

409.description: Stored evidence cannot be read as an Agent execution.

get.summary: List every API key, newest first.

post.summary: Create an Application Telemetry API key.
post.description:
Keys are a shared resource: any signed-in user may create, list, and
delete them.

get.summary: Return the signed-in user's email.

post.description:
Public: the terminal that asks has no credential yet. Starting also
deletes every expired sign-in.

post.summary: Collect the token of a CLI sign-in.
post.description:
Public: the device code is the credential. The token is returned once,
and the sign-in is deleted with it. Until then the answer is a 400 whose
code says why: `authorization_pending` while the sign-in is undecided,
`access_denied` once when it was denied, and `expired_token` when the
device code is unknown, already used, or expired.

200.description: The token. It is returned once.

get.summary: Get a pending CLI sign-in, for the approval page.

parameters.name: user_code
parameters.description: The user code, in either case, with or without its hyphen.

post.description:
This mints a developer access token with the name and the scopes the
terminal asked for and no expiry. It belongs to the approving user, and
the terminal collects it.

parameters.name: user_code
parameters.description: The user code, in either case, with or without its hyphen.

post.summary: Deny a pending CLI sign-in. The terminal is told once and gets no token.

parameters.name: user_code
parameters.description: The user code, in either case, with or without its hyphen.

get.summary: Get runtime configuration.
get.description:
Public: it reports only where SDKs send telemetry and which environment
this deployment runs in.

get.summary: List developer access tokens, newest first.
Describe the developer access token that makes the request.
get.description:
Any valid token may ask, whatever its scopes. A browser session is not a
credential for this route.

200.description: The token that made the request.

delete.summary: Delete the developer access token that makes the request.
delete.description:
It stops working on the next request. Any valid token may revoke itself,
whatever its scopes. A browser session is not a credential for this route.

delete.summary: Delete one developer access token. It stops working on the next request.

Create a user. Users are equal: any signed-in user may create, list, and
delete users.

post.summary: Create the first user and sign them in.
post.description:
Public so a fresh deployment can bootstrap. It is refused once any user
exists.

200.description: The first user was created and signed in.

get.summary: Report whether any user exists.
get.description:
Public: a fresh deployment uses it to decide between first-user setup and
sign-in.

Delete one user. Their sessions and developer access tokens stop working
on the next request.

an Agent's private runtime state.

operation_type.description: The discriminator value of a Tool operation.

TraceEvidence.description: Complete normalized telemetry plus generic verified annotations.

TraceManifestSummary.description: Bounded identity and shape facts for one trace.

What a Store is to one execution: the application state it works on, or
